ai_summary: Canara HSBC Life Insurance reported healthy H1 FY27 results with strong growth in New Business Premium (16.1%) and Value of New Business (VNB) (24%), particularly driven by a 44% surge in its protection business, contributing to a robust Embedded Value of ₹7,622 crore and operating RoEV of 19.8%. However, Profit After Tax (PAT) growth of 10.8% significantly lagged VNB growth, likely impacted by a rising expense ratio (from 19.0% to 20.5%) and a notable decline in the Solvency Ratio from 198% to 180%, which, while still above regulatory minimums, warrants monitoring for future sustainability.
